pages.text: Build a frame of $(l)glowstone$() and pour water into it.

The Aether is a realm of floating islands. Mind the edges. Tools climb from skyroot and holystone to $(l:realms/aether#zanite_gemstone)Zanite$(/l) and gravitite. $(l:realms/aether#ambrosium_shard)Ambrosium$(/l) fuels the $(l:realms/aether#altar)Altar$(/l), and $(l:realms/aether#enchanted_gravitite)Enchanted Gravitite$(/l) makes the finest gear.$(br2)Three dungeons, each with a guardian and a key: $(l:realms/aether#bronze_dungeon_key)Bronze Key$(/l), $(l:realms/aether#silver_dungeon_key)Silver Key$(/l), $(l:realms/aether#gold_dungeon_key)Gold Key$(/l).
Enchants Aether gear, fuelled by ambrosium.
